sections.text_helper: Section 16.2 "EXTI block diagram" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 446.
sections.section_content:
The EXTI consists of a register block accessed via an AHB interface, the event input trigger
block, the masking block and EXTI mux as shown in Figure58.
The register block contains all EXTI registers. The event input trigger block provides event
input edge trigger logic. The masking block provides the event input distribution to the
different wake-up, interrupt, and event outputs, and their masking.
The EXTI mux provides the I/O port selection on to the EXTI event signal.
